evals.name: new-drawing-into-note
evals.prompt: can you draw me an excalidraw diagram of how my daily notes get into the vault — I write one in obsidian with the calendar, it lands in raw/daily, gets compiled word for word into the work log or the journal, the facts get distilled into nodes, then the note moves to raw/_compiled. put it in the capture protocol note so I can keep editing it later
evals.expected_output: An editable Excalidraw/tooling/<name>.excalidraw.md drawing of the flow, embedded live in wiki/tooling/vault-capture-protocol.md with a transcription and matching drawing-hash; the vault builds clean.
assertions: An editable drawing in the plugin's .excalidraw.md format was created under Excalidraw/<topic>/
Obsidian would read every label back correctly (8-character text ids, D73)
The drawing shows the whole flow: raw/daily, the work log, the journal, nodes, raw/_compiled
At least four arrows, every one bound to shapes at both ends
The drawing lints with no errors (overlaps, clipped labels, arrows through shapes)
vault-capture-protocol.md embeds the live drawing, not a PNG
The embed's section carries a transcription of at least 200 characters
The note records a drawing-hash matching the drawing
The vault builds with no problems under the drawing-aware builder

evals.name: edit-owner-drawing
evals.prompt: in my latest excalidraw drawing the data-quality checks are in the wrong place, they run after the customer build, not before. fix that, and add a parallel-run step at the end — dashed, since it hasn't started yet. also give the file a proper name instead of the date
evals.expected_output: The plugin-saved (compressed, CRLF) drawing reordered to Raw files → Customer build → DQ checks → Warehouse load → dashed Parallel run, renamed to kebab-case, with its element link and note text intact.
assertions: The date-named drawing was renamed to a descriptive kebab-case .excalidraw.md
Obsidian would read every label back correctly (8-character text ids, D73)
The drawing is still in the plugin's format and parses
Connectors run Raw files → Customer build → DQ checks → Warehouse load, with no leftover old links
The boxes are laid out left to right in the corrected order
A parallel-run step is connected after Warehouse load
The parallel-run step is dashed
The Customer build box keeps its element link to [[customer-migration]]
The owner's note "customer pipeline - check with Sam" survives
The drawing lints with no errors

evals.name: extend-embedded-drawing
evals.prompt: on the query ladder drawing, add the Now page as a shortcut: status questions ("what's my status?") skip the ladder and go straight to the now card. keep the note that shows it in sync
evals.expected_output: query-ladder.excalidraw.md gains a Now card connected from Question and labelled for status questions; the vault-operations figure transcription and drawing-hash are updated; the build has no stale-drawing warning.
files: seeds/query-ladder.excalidraw.md (copied to Excalidraw/tooling/), with a Figure section already in wiki/tooling/vault-operations.md
assertions: query-ladder.excalidraw.md is still in place and parses
Obsidian would read every label back correctly (8-character text ids, D73)
A shape for the Now page / now card was added
A bound arrow connects Question to the Now shape
The drawing says the shortcut is for status questions
The existing ladder L0–L3 is intact
The drawing lints with no errors
The note's transcription now covers the Now shortcut for status questions
The note's drawing-hash matches the edited drawing
The vault builds with no problems and no stale-drawing warning
